description: Shortens the ZERO-LEVEL sections of a sound by a percentage - silence liposuction. 0-100 removes that percentage of each silent stretch; values above 100 additionally OVERLAP the sound on either side by (constriction - 100)%. Verified on a 4-event fixture with real silences (3.0 s): 50 -> 2.2749 s, 100 -> 1.6998 s (all detected silence gone), 200 -> 0.7496 s (events overlapping); material with NO zero-level sections passes through at indur minus ONE frame (flat noise 88200 -> 88199). The duration is content-dependent (how much silence the file contains), so the model is pinned static for the no-silence bound - real shrinkage is documented here, not modelled. CONSTRICTION IS BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE - the only time-variable parameter found in this tranche's editing family (brk 10->190 renders distinct from both scalar endpoints, verified). Deterministic; mono and stereo accepted.
musical_use: Tighten performance timing without touching the sound itself: pull the dead air out of a spoken take (50-80% keeps natural breathing; 100% is broadcast-tight), compress the gaps of a sparse texture until events start to converse, or push past 100 so events physically overlap and a phrase becomes a chord-cloud - 200% halves the space AND collides neighbours. Time-varying constriction is the composed accelerando of silence: a 0-to-200 breakpoint ramp leaves the opening spacious and piles the ending into itself. Note it only acts on EXACT zero-level samples - gate or noisecut first if your 'silences' have a floor. The inverse move (adding gaps) is manysil.

constriction.description: Percentage deletion of zero-level areas, enforced 0-200 verbatim ('Parameter[1] Value (250.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 200.000000)'; -10 likewise). 0-100 shortens each silence by that fraction; >100 also overlaps the flanking sound by (value - 100)%. BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: a 10->190 brk over the file renders distinct from both scalar endpoints; out-of-range values inside a brk are refused 'Value (...) out of range (...) in brkpntfile <name>.'). Required.

examples.description: Halve every silence in a spoken phrase.
examples.expected_use: Each zero-level stretch loses half its length (4-event probe: 3.0 s -> 2.2749 s); the sounding material is untouched.

examples.description: Progressive collapse from spacious to colliding.
examples.expected_use: Early gaps keep their length; later ones vanish and events overlap - a written-in accelerando of density.

known_issues: Duration is CONTENT-DEPENDENT: the static model is exact only for material without zero-level sections (flat noise loses a single frame, 88200 -> 88199 - the model's fixture case); with real silences the output shrinks by up to the whole silent budget (verified 3.0 -> 0.75 at 200%). The engine's prediction is an upper bound on silent material.
Only EXACT digital zeros count as silence - low-level noise floors defeat it (pre-gate if needed).
constriction > 100 overlaps material; expect summation level rises at the joins.
constriction is breakpoint-capable (first-class: the tranche's editing family otherwise refuses brks everywhere); in-brk values are range-checked verbatim.
Deterministic (identical decoded shas 1.2 s apart); stereo accepted (same single-frame quirk).
